{{Short description|Singaporean materials scientist}}

'''Xiaodong Chen''' is a Singaporean materials scientist and Distinguished University Professor at [[Nanyang Technological University]]. He holds a primary appointment as Professor of Materials Science and Engineering, Professor of Chemistry and Medicine (by courtesy) at the university.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/cris/rp/rp00467|title=Prof Chen Xiaodong &#124; Academic Profile &#124; DR-NTU &#124; Research|website=dr.ntu.edu.sg|access-date=2024-03-19|archive-date=2024-03-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240319064301/https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/cris/rp/rp00467|url-status=dead}}</ref> He is a fellow of the [[Royal Society]], the UK’s national academy of sciences,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fellow Detail Page {{!}} Royal Society |url=https://royalsociety.org/people/xiaodong-chen-37377/ |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=royalsociety.org |language=en}}</ref> member of the [[German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Celebrating Prof Chen Xiaodong's Election to the Prestigious German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina |url=https://www.ntu.edu.sg/mse/news-events/news/detail/celebrating-prof-chen-xiaodong%27s-election-to-the-prestigious-german-national-academy-of-sciences-leopoldina |access-date=2024-06-26 |url-status=live }}</ref> fellow of [[Singapore National Academy of Science]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Current Fellows |url=https://snas.org.sg/fellowship-fellows |access-date=2024-06-26 Chen is known for his development of soft conformal materials for bioelectronic interfaces in elevating the sensing capability of sensor systems beyond human senses, and contributions to material science, chemistry, nanotechnology, energy storage and flexible electronics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=President's Science Award 2021 - Professor Chen Xiaodong |url=https://www.ntu.edu.sg/mse/news-events/news/detail/president's-science-award-2021---professor-chen-xiaodong |access-date=2024-06-26 |website=School of Materials Science and Engineering |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=President's Science Award (PSA) |url=https://www.psta.gov.sg/winners/2021/psa/ |access-date=2024-06-26 |website=www.psta.gov.sg |language=en |archive-date=2024-06-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240626113620/https://www.psta.gov.sg/winners/2021/psa/ |url-status=live }}</ref> 

== Career ==
Chen received his B.S. degree in Chemistry from Fuzhou University, China, his M.S. in [[Physical chemistry|Physical Chemistry]] from the Institute of Chemistry, the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], China, and his PhD in Biochemistry (''Summa Cum Laude'') from the [[University of Münster]], Germany. In 2006, he was a postdoctoral research fellow at the Department of Chemistry, Northwestern University, USA, where he worked with Professor [[Chad Mirkin]] on molecular electronics based on nanomaterials. In 2009, He started his professorship career at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore<ref>{{Cite web |title=Chen Xiaodong - SHARE |url=https://www.share-huj.edu.sg/staff/chen-xiaodong |access-date=2024-06-26 |website=www.share-huj.edu.sg |archive-date=2024-06-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240626113620/https://www.share-huj.edu.sg/staff/chen-xiaodong |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof Chen Xiaodong {{!}} Academic Profile {{!}} DR-NTU {{!}} Research |url=https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/cris/uuid/b3ed3220-e7e3-4c97-8afa-6b119a22185f |access-date=2024-06-26 |website=dr.ntu.edu.sg }}{{Dead link|date=November 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

His current roles include the director of the Innovative Centre for Flexible Devices (iFLEX) at NTU,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Xiaodong Chen |url=https://research.a-star.edu.sg/researcher/xiaodong-chen/ |access-date=2024-06-26 |website=A*STAR Research |language=en-US}}</ref> the director of Max Planck – NTU Joint Lab for Artificial Senses<ref>{{Cite web |title=About Us |url=https://www.ntu.edu.sg/max-planck/about-us |access-date=2024-06-26 |website=Max Planck - NTU Joint Lab for Artificial Senses |language=en |archive-date=2024-06-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240625204218/https://www.ntu.edu.sg/max-planck/about-us |url-status=live }}</ref> and the deputy director of the Singapore Hybrid-Integrated Next-Generation μ-Electronics (SHINE) Center at NTU.<ref>{{Cite web |title=People |url=https://shine.nus.edu.sg/people/ |access-date=2024-06-26 |website=shine.nus.edu.sg |archive-date=2024-07-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240719021858/https://shine.nus.edu.sg/people/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He is also the Editor-in-chief of [[ACS Nano]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pubs.acs.org/page/ancac3/profile.html|title=Editor-in-Chief|access-date=2024-03-19|archive-date=2024-03-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240319040710/https://pubs.acs.org/page/ancac3/profile.html|url-status=live}}</ref> He was the Scientific Director at the Institute of Materials Research and Engineering, Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) between 2021 and 2023.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://research.a-star.edu.sg/articles/features/recognising-research-excellence-and-outstanding-scientists/|title=Recognising research excellence and outstanding scientists|website=A*STAR Research}}</ref> 

== Research ==
